Manchester Airport is a single GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Its 26 polygons outline
terminals and aprons, 254 lines trace runways and taxiways, and 136 points mark
gates and other airfield features. Pass the collection to `hchart()` to draw the
three layers. Hover over a gate to see its reference, such as **Gate 21**.

```{r manchester-airport}
library(geojsonio)

path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "manchester-airport.geojson",
  package = "highcharter"
)
airport <- geojson_list(as.json(path))

airport_map <- hchart(airport, name = c("Areas", "Lines", "Points")) |>
  hc_tooltip(headerFormat = "", pointFormat = "<b>{point.name}</b>") |>
  hc_mapNavigation(enabled = TRUE, enableMouseWheelZoom = FALSE)
```

The example below adds a local MapLibre basemap for context. Toggle a layer in
the legend or use the zoom buttons to explore. The GeoJSON preserves named features
and labels the others with their airfield category and reference where available.
[Airport data from POSCON UK](https://github.com/POSCON-United-Kingdom/UK-Radar-Data/blob/6a020b03fbfeffe9f7eb53e4b4559de48134e351/AirfieldGeoJson/EGCC.geojson) ·
[Basemap example code](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter/blob/main/vignettes/_manchester.Rmd).

```{r manchester-basemap, echo=FALSE}
airport_map <- airport_map |>
  hc_title(text = "Manchester Airport") |>
  hc_chart(
    backgroundColor = "transparent",
    plotBackgroundColor = "transparent"
  ) |>
  hc_mapView(projection = list(name = "WebMercator")) |>
  hc_plotOptions(
    map = list(color = "rgba(80,157,178,0.25)", borderColor = "#517973"),
    mapline = list(color = "#245A72", lineWidth = 1.5),
    mappoint = list(
      color = "#C65D18",
      marker = list(symbol = "circle", radius = 2.6)
    ),
    series = list(dataLabels = list(enabled = FALSE))
  ) |>
  hc_legend(enabled = TRUE) |>
  hc_caption(
    text = paste(
      "Highcharts · Airport: POSCON UK · Basemap: OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles ·",
      "<a href='https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright'>© OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)</a>"
    )
  )

deps <- htmlwidgets::getDependency("maplibregl", "mapgl")
maplibre <- Filter(function(dep) identical(dep$name, "maplibre-gl"), deps)
stopifnot(length(maplibre) == 1L)
airport_map$dependencies <- c(airport_map$dependencies, maplibre)
background <- jsonlite::read_json("data/manchester-basemap.geojson.gz")
airport_map |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    paste(readLines("manchester-basemap.js"), collapse = "\n"),
    data = background
  )
```
